title: Log in to Cloudflare once, then deploy the 2 demo gates
instructions: Right now both demos are public without the gate (Access is off, the new version is not deployed yet), so please do this soon. In Terminal, in the project folder: 1) npx wrangler login  (opens the browser; the login is saved for every terminal, so no token to set again). 2) bash out/cf-review/deploy.sh  (it checks, asks you to confirm, deploys both and prints PASS/FAIL). Tap Done when it says ALL PASS, or paste only the FAIL lines.
